data: Which sentence has the highest BLEU score?

The scatter plot in Figure 10 shows the relationship between log-probability and BLEU scores for samples generated by a model for four different sentences. The x-axis represents the BLEU score, and the y-axis represents the log-probability. Each color corresponds to a different test sentence.

To determine which sentence has the highest BLEU score, we need to look at the distribution of points along the x-axis (BLEU score). The higher the BLEU score, the more likely the sample is a valid translation.

From the figure, we can see that the points for Sent #2375 (purple) are distributed at the highest values on the x-axis compared to the other sentences. This indicates that Sent #2375 has the highest BLEU score among the four sentences shown in the figure.
